metadata.question: Does Kerala, India experience more rainfall between July and August 2018 compared to Sri Lanka?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Location: Kerala, India vs. Sri Lanka (both are geographical regions) - Date: July-August 2018 - Data: Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) dataset, which is ideal for rainfall analysis and has global coverage - Collection: "UCSB/CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY" for daily precipitation data 2. Masking Strategy: - CHIRPS data is already quality-controlled precipitation estimates; no cloud masking needed in the traditional sense - Focus on calculating mean/total rainfall for both regions in the specified period 3. Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid Zero: Both regions have measurable rainfall (even if one is higher, we compare) - Null/Error (C3): If computed values are negative, NaN, or completely invalid - Empty Collection (C1): If no images found for July-August 2018 - No Valid Pixels (C2): If after filtering, pixel count is 0 (unlikely for this global dataset, but check) - Answer A: If Kerala rainfall > Sri Lanka rainfall - Answer B: If Kerala rainfall ≤ Sri Lanka rainfall ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Kerala and Sri Lanka const kerala = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([74.1, 8.1, 77.5, 12.2]); const sriLanka = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([80.0, 5.9, 81.9, 7.7]); // 2. Load CHIRPS daily precipitation data for July-August 2018 const startDate = ee.Date('2018-07-01'); const endDate = ee.Date('2018-08-31'); const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB/CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check if collection has data const size = chirps.size().getInfo(); print('CHIRPS images found (Jul-Aug 2018): ' + size); if (size === 0) { print('No data found for July-August 2018'); print('C1'); return; } // 3. Sum up total precipitation for both regions const totalPrecip = chirps.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); // 4. Calculate mean/total rainfall for Kerala const keralaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kerala, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const keralaRainfall = keralaStats.precipitation; // 5. Calculate mean/total rainfall for Sri Lanka const sriLankaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sriLanka, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sriLankaRainfall = sriLankaStats.precipitation; // 6. Validation checks print('Kerala mean rainfall (mm): ' + (keralaRainfall ? keralaRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null')); print('Sri Lanka mean rainfall (mm): ' + (sriLankaRainfall ? sriLankaRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null')); if (keralaRainfall === null || keralaRainfall === undefined || sriLankaRainfall === null || sriLankaRainfall === undefined) { print('Calculation failure: null or undefined values'); print('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(keralaRainfall) || isNaN(sriLankaRainfall)) { print('Invalid values (NaN) in rainfall calculation'); print('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare rainfall const difference = keralaRainfall - sriLankaRainfall; print('Difference (Kerala - Sri Lanka): ' + difference.toFixed(2) + ' mm'); if (keralaRainfall > sriLankaRainfall) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
